chunks: And do not call upon any other god besides Allah. There is no deity except Him. Every thing will perish except His Face. His is the command, and to Him you will be returned.

key_terms.وَجْهَهُ: His Face (symbolizing His eternal essence and presence)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the permanence of God versus the perishability of creation?
ai.summary: Found in Surah Al-Qasas, this verse serves as a bridge between the narrative of Prophet Musa and the core tenet of Tawhid, warning against polytheism by contrasting the fleeting nature of all created beings with the eternal 'Face' (Wajh) of Allah. In Shia exegesis, this impermanence of creation underscores the necessity of returning to the Divine Command, reinforcing the concept of ultimate accountability and the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the enduring manifestation of Allah's will.
